_readme: Six playlists, one per branch of the Music chapter.
A song is a YouTube link and a name. Paste the link — the whole URL,
or just the id after v= — and write what it is. The thumbnail comes
down from YouTube on its own; there is nothing to upload and no audio
file anywhere in this repository, which is both the legal position and
the reason adding a song takes ten seconds.
`artist` is optional. `mood` is not yours to edit lightly — it is what
the whole site turns into while that playlist is playing.
